expectations.text: B1: Picks a matching upstream entry and scaffolds the first milestone; no full server
expectations.evidence: Picks a matching catalog entry: 'Tutorial: Building a DNS server in Rust (Emil Hernvall)' with link, chosen after grepping tutorials.md for DNS. First milestone is scaffolded as the immediate step ('1. Skeleton — cargo project, UDP socket on 127.0.0.1:5353, echoes packets back') while 'FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0)' confirms no full multi-milestone server was dumped; agent stops at 'milestone 1/7 — pick + scope' and asks to confirm scope.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: 'Check (run this now): cargo --version && dig -v | head -1 — expect cargo 1.95.0 and a dig version line. If dig is missing, nslookup works too' — concrete command plus expected output and fallback behaviour.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions UDP port 53 (or a high test port) and the DNS message header/question format
expectations.evidence: Port: 'UDP socket on 127.0.0.1:5353' and 'dig @127.0.0.1 -p 5353' (high test port). Format: 'a 12-byte header (ID, flags, four section counts), a question section (name + type + class)', plus 'length-prefixed labels (example.test → \x07example\x04test\x00)' and record fields 'name, type, TTL, length, data'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command run was a read-only version probe: 'for t in cargo rustc node npm python3 go; do command -v $t ... --version ...' — no brew/apt/pip/cargo install/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install. 'FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0)' and all other calls are reads/globs/greps under .agents/skills; nothing written outside the project and no install needed (tools reported present: 'Rust 1.95, Node 25, and Python 3.14').
